name: Scandinavian — Nf6 Modern (Icelandic Gambit)
description: Black plays 2...Nf6, avoiding the early queen sortie entirely. After 3.c4, Black offers the genuine Icelandic Gambit with 3...e6: 4.dxe6 Bxe6 surrenders a pawn for rapid development and lasting pressure on White's center. White's critical test is the solid 5.Nf3 — Black must prove real compensation for the missing pawn.

lines.name: Scandinavian — Nf6 Modern (Icelandic Gambit)
lines.description: The real Icelandic Gambit: 3...e6 4.dxe6 Bxe6. White accepts and plays the critical 5.Nf3, developing before Black's initiative can grow. Black develops rapidly with ...Nc6 and ...Bc5, castles, and keeps the pressure on — the pawn is gone, but the activity remains.
